title: Provisional Mismatch Field Candidate
purpose: Introduce a provisional mismatch field candidate downstream of ordinal mismatch transition and admissibility-boundary dynamics, without introducing scalar metrics, units, topology, coordinates, or empirical physical interpretation.
summary: This patch defines the first candidate organization of repeated Delta evaluations. The field is not yet a metric space. It records governed variation of ordinal mismatch evaluations across declared domain, scale, residue-asymmetry, and symmetry-reference coupling conditions.

core_rule.statement: Repeated Delta evaluations may be organized as a provisional field candidate only when each evaluation is tied to a declared Ctx_Δ and preserved as trace-linked ordinal variation; this reading does not introduce scalar magnitude, topology, units, coordinates, or physical field claims.

basis.scope: Provisional field-candidate witness that extends the governed ordinal transition and admissibility-boundary layers into a traceable organization of repeated Delta evaluations while leaving RT_core unchanged and keeping quantitative metric construction deferred.

MismatchFieldCandidate.definition: A provisional organization of repeated Delta evaluations over declared evaluation contexts.
MismatchFieldCandidate.canonical_form: MF_Δ := FieldCandidate({ Delta_i(A_i <S_i>_{r_a,i} E_i) } over declared evaluation context Ctx_Δ,i)

EvaluationContext.definition: The declared context required for any field-candidate reading of Delta evaluations.

FieldTrace.definition: The ordered diagnostic record of repeated Delta evaluations and ordinal transitions used to support a field-candidate reading.
FieldTrace.note: Trace(MF_Δ) is diagnostic, not itself a metric or topology.

formal_reading.field_candidate: MF_Δ := FieldCandidate({ Delta_i(A_i <S_i>_{r_a,i} E_i) } | Ctx_Δ declared for each i)
formal_reading.ordinal_projection: class(Delta_i) in { NO_EXPRESSED_MISMATCH, LOW_MISMATCH, MODERATE_MISMATCH, HIGH_MISMATCH, ADMISSIBILITY_BREAK }
formal_reading.transition_dependency: Ordinal transitions remain governed by PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_055.
formal_reading.boundary_dependency: Admissibility-boundary behavior remains governed by PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_056.

governance_rules.rule: MF_Δ may be introduced only after Delta evaluation, ordinal class, transition discipline, and admissibility-boundary state are declared.
MF_Δ does not introduce scalar magnitude, equal spacing, coordinate distance, topology, unit, or physical metric.
Variation across repeated Delta evaluations may be described qualitatively as a provisional field only when the evaluation contexts are explicitly recorded.
A field-candidate reading is invalid if it collapses Delta into distance(A,E) or treats <S> as midpoint, endpoint, substrate, or metric center.
MF_Δ does not modify RT_core and does not promote projection from provisional induction to theorem.

forbidden_inferences: MF_Δ is not a metric space.
MF_Δ is not a vector field.
MF_Δ is not a scalar field.
MF_Δ is not a physical field.
MF_Δ does not imply continuity in the analytic sense.
MF_Δ does not imply numerical magnitude.
MF_Δ does not license empirical measurement claims.
admissibility_conditions: Each Delta evaluation must have a declared Ctx_Δ.
Each ordinal class assignment must be traceable to governed Delta evaluation.
Each transition between ordinal classes must obey PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_055.
Each boundary-related state must obey PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_056.
FieldTrace must preserve evaluation order and context identity.

failure_modes.FAIL_MF_UNDECLARED_CONTEXT: A field-candidate reading is attempted without declared Ctx_Δ.
failure_modes.FAIL_MF_NUMERIC_IMPORT: Scalar, unit, coordinate, or metric magnitude is introduced without governance.
failure_modes.FAIL_MF_TOPOLOGY_IMPORT: Topological or manifold language is introduced before topology governance.
failure_modes.FAIL_MF_DELTA_COLLAPSE: Delta is treated as distance, norm, or physical metric.
failure_modes.FAIL_MF_TRACE_BREAK: Repeated evaluations cannot be trace-linked under declared context.

textbook_integration.recommended_location: After Delta Ordinal Transition Discipline and Admissibility Boundary Dynamics.
textbook_integration.integration_note: Present this as the first field-candidate layer, not as a completed field or metric space.

next_expected_patch.title: Emergent Metric Structure Candidate
